The proposed absorber has a thickness of 2.0 mm
The absorber exhibits a broad bandwidth for reflection equal or less than -10 dB for incidence angle up to 60° for TM polarization
The improvement of oblique-incidence absorption for TM polarization is related to LC resonance caused by the embedded dipoles
The resonance frequency for TE polarization is around 11.5 GHz
The absorption bandwidth for TM polarization at normal incidence is 5.0 GHz ~15.7 GHz
The absorption bandwidth for TM polarization at 45° incidence is 4.5 GHz ~14.8 GHz
The equivalent circuit method is used to analyze the absorption mechanism
The absorber is made of a magnetic polymer composite with metallic dipole arrays
The dipoles are incorporated into the magnetic absorbing sheet
The period of the unit cell is 6.0 mm
The length of the dipole is 4.0 mm
The width of the dipole is 1 mm
The position of the dipole arrays is 1.0 mm
The relative permittivity of the magnetic sheet material is around 6.5
The relative permeability of the magnetic sheet material is around 6.5
